root_cause.text: In `rawsock_release()`, the `tx_work` work item is not canceled or synchronized before the socket is orphaned, allowing a race condition where `rawsock_tx_work` may continue to run and dereference the NCI device after it has been freed, leading to use-after-free.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description explicitly states: "rawsock_tx_work runs on the system workqueue and calls nfc_data_exchange which dereferences the NCI device. Without synchronization, tx_work can race with socket and device teardown..." The patch adds `sk->sk_shutdown |= SEND_SHUTDOWN; cancel_work_sync(&nfc_rawsock(sk)->tx_work); rawsock_write_queue_purge(sk);` before `sock_orphan(sk)` to prevent this race.
